design-spec-optimizer v1.0.0

- Initial release of a tool for optimizing user-submitted product/interface design ideas into detailed, structured design specs.
- Automatically expands simple ideas into 5 standardized modules: product positioning, device specs, page list, user flow, and visual style.
- Includes inquiry logic to clarify missing key details, ensuring outputs are always complete and actionable.
- Designed for interface products including mini-programs, apps, web, and H5. 
- Enforces concrete, real-world data examples and specific, quantifiable design parameters in every output.
